updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention: Entra Global Secure Access Integration Now Generally Available
updates.summary: Purview DLP now integrates with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access to protect data at the network layer, enforcing restrictive actions and detecting risky user activity across browsers, apps, APIs, and generative AI platforms. This enables admins to prevent sensitive data from reaching untrusted cloud applications through a unified network and policy enforcement point.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention: Non-Microsoft Connected Apps Support in Preview
updates.summary: Admins can now create DLP policies that protect sensitive data at rest in non-Microsoft applications like Box and Google Workspace, leveraging existing Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps connectors and Purview's classification engine. This extends consistent data loss prevention controls beyond the Microsoft 365 ecosystem.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention: Upgraded Inline Protection for Entra-Managed Apps in Edge for Business
updates.summary: Purview DLP inline protection for Microsoft Entra-managed apps in Edge for Business now integrates with Conditional Access grant controls and supports expanded conditions, multiple activities per rule, simulation mode, and configurable alerts. This simplifies policy configuration while increasing flexibility for protecting sensitive data in managed browser environments.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention: Expanded Inline Protection for Unmanaged Apps in Edge for Business
updates.summary: Purview DLP policies will soon support inline protection in Edge for Business for a broader set of unmanaged generative AI and cloud applications, allowing admins to detect and protect sensitive data shared through these services using existing policy experiences. This extends consistent security controls across more SaaS destinations without requiring separate integrations.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention: User-Based Alert Aggregation
updates.summary: Upcoming DLP alert aggregation will consolidate multiple rule-match events for the same user into a single alert, reducing noise and simplifying investigation workflows. This enhancement helps security teams focus on meaningful violations rather than processing redundant alerts.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management: Automated Deletion of Inactive OneDrives and Mailboxes
updates.summary: Purview will enable admins to automatically delete both content and containers for departed users at scale, maintaining tenant compliance without manual intervention. This streamlines offboarding workflows and reduces storage costs associated with inactive user accounts.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management: Insights and Recommendations for Sensitive Data
updates.summary: Purview will provide insights on sensitive data in OneDrive and SharePoint along with automated retention policy recommendations to improve data governance and compliance posture. This helps admins identify and govern high-risk data more effectively.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management: Archive SharePoint Files Under Retention Policies
updates.summary: Admins will soon be able to include file archiving actions within retention policies, moving inactive content to low-cost storage while keeping data discoverable and compliant. This extends data lifecycle management capabilities beyond deletion and retention.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management: Legacy Teams Retention Policies Scope Change for Copilot
updates.summary: Existing Teams retention policies that currently apply to both Teams and Microsoft 365 Copilot interactions will be converted to Teams-only policies, no longer implicitly governing Copilot workloads. Admins should audit their retention policies to ensure Copilot data is governed by separate policies if needed.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview eDiscovery: In-Product Self-Service Diagnostics
updates.summary: eDiscovery will introduce self-service diagnostics that identify common issues with case permissions, security filters, and policy status, highlighting misconfigurations and providing remediation guidance. This reduces the need for support escalations and helps admins troubleshoot problems independently.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Unified Classification Management Experience
updates.summary: Purview will consolidate all classifiers—Sensitive Information Types, Exact Data Match, fingerprint SITs, and trainable classifiers—into a single unified interface for discovery, creation, validation, and management. This simplifies classifier lifecycle management and improves consistency across Purview policies.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP: Pre-Curated File Extension Support
updates.summary: Endpoint DLP now provides a pre-curated list of supported file extensions for the file extension condition, replacing free-form text entry to prevent unsupported extensions and reduce endpoint processing overhead. This improves policy reliability and reduces false positives.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention: Island Enterprise Browser Integration
updates.summary: Purview network data security will integrate with Island Enterprise Browser to extend DLP and data protection policies to browser-based workflows, detecting and protecting data shared with unmanaged cloud apps through Island's browser, extension, and add-ins. This closes visibility and protection gaps in browser-based user activity.

updates.title: CVE-2026-77903: Microsoft Dataverse Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: An authentication bypass vulnerability in Microsoft Dataverse allows unauthorized attackers to elevate privileges over the network through spoofing attacks. Organizations should apply available patches promptly to prevent unauthorized privilege escalation in their Dataverse environments.

updates.title: CVE-2026-85889: Azure AI Foundry Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: Missing authentication for a critical function in Azure AI Foundry enables unauthorized attackers to escalate privileges over the network. Admins managing Azure AI Foundry deployments should prioritize patching this vulnerability to secure their AI infrastructure.

updates.title: CVE-2026-69843: Microsoft Fabric Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: An authentication bypass vulnerability in Microsoft Fabric allows unauthorized attackers to escalate privileges through spoofing attacks over the network. This affects identity and access controls within Fabric and requires immediate patching.

updates.title: CVE-2026-69865: Microsoft Container Registry Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: An authorization bypass vulnerability in Microsoft Container Registry through user-controlled keys allows unauthorized attackers to escalate privileges over the network. This affects identity-based access controls and container image security.

updates.title: CVE-2026-68791: Azure Machine Learning Information Disclosure Vulnerability
updates.summary: Incorrect authorization in Azure Machine Learning allows unauthorized attackers to disclose sensitive information over the network. Admins should review access controls and apply patches to prevent unauthorized data exposure.

updates.title: CVE-2026-85878: Azure Database for PostgreSQL Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: An improper authorization vulnerability in Azure Database for PostgreSQL allows authorized attackers to escalate privileges over the network. Admins should review database role assignments and apply patches to prevent lateral privilege escalation.
